First release.

Auto Group is a Chrome (Manifest V3) extension that groups tabs automatically with regex rules.

## Highlights

- **One group per matched value.** A single rule in *per-match* mode turns every distinct match into
  its own group, so `ticket-123`, `ticket-456` and `ticket-789` each get a group even when the tabs
  come from different sites.
- **`groups | ungrouped` ordering.** Groups stay contiguous on the left, ungrouped tabs on the
  right, and a new group lands after the existing groups and before the first ungrouped tab.
- **Regex matching** against the title, the URL, or both, with `wildcard`, `contains`, `startsWith`,
  `endsWith`, `exact` and `domain` modes, plus alternative patterns and capture groups.
- **Import that merges instead of overwriting**, for Tab Modifier / Tabee, Simple Tab Groups,
  Tab Groups Extension, Auto-Group Tabs (loilo), Auto Tab Groups (nitzanpap) and several session
  exports.
- **Guarded against catastrophic regex backtracking**, so an imported pattern cannot hang the
  extension.

## Notes

- Chromium-based browsers only — it uses the Manifest V3 `tabGroups` API and will not run on
  Firefox.
- Only six import formats have been verified against a real export; the rest are written from their
  published formats and are unverified. See the README and `docs/DESIGN.md`.
- Reordering moves tabs one at a time, so very large windows can briefly churn.
- Not affiliated with, sponsored by or endorsed by any of the extensions whose formats it reads.

## Install

Download `auto-group.zip`, unzip it, then open `chrome://extensions`, enable **Developer mode** and
click **Load unpacked**, selecting the unzipped folder.
